What happens to my Student visa, will my university handle the change from four years to three or is that something I have to do myself, and is there anything I need to do before I can switch?

answer.summary: Your university has to tell the Home Office if your course is shortened, and leaving an integrated master's with the lower degree counts as successfully completing the course. The Home Office would then normally cut your Student visa short but leave you the same wrap-up period after your new end date. To switch, you must have finished your sponsored course, or your job must start after it ends, on the date you apply, and you must not travel outside the UK, Ireland, the Channel Islands or the Isle of Man until you get a decision. The guidance I found doesn't say whether you also need to tell the Home Office yourself.
